title: Vault Bridge project config (.vaultbridge.json)
description: Links this project to its Obsidian vault and controls git auto-commit/push of the vault. Overrides Settings | Tools | Vault Bridge while the file exists.

vault.description: Obsidian vault folder (the one with .obsidian/): relative to the project root, absolute, or ~/...

git.description: Git sync of the vault. Remove the whole block to turn it off.

autoCommit.description: Commit changed notes automatically (only when the vault is a git repository and something changed).

commitInterval.description: How often to look for changes: 30s, 5m, 1h, 1h30m. Minimum 30s.

push.description: Push commits to the vault repository's existing remote. Never adds remotes, never force-pushes.

pushInterval.description: How often to push when push is true. Minimum 1m.

remote.description: Optional git URL of the vault. Used to offer "Clone vault" when the vault folder does not exist.
